_how: Hand-entered screenings for venues with no scrapeable schedule (e.g. the Palace, whose tickets are on AXS).
Add the venue once under theaters (id, name, neighborhood, address, url), and add its id with an area and map
coordinates to GEO in build.py. Then add each screening: theater (the venue id), title (the film, so posters match),
start as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' in Los Angeles time, and url (tickets). year, director, runtime, blurb and image are
optional. Mention a Q&A or 35mm in the blurb and the site tags it. Past screenings drop off by themselves, so old
entries can stay or be deleted. A malformed entry is skipped and named in the scrape log; the rest still list.
Only for venues no scraper covers: a screening for a theater not listed here is ignored.
